_comment: Data for setup.ps1 -InstallPython (R6), read by scripts/lib/rt-python-env.ps1 and scripts/docs/python_libs.py. One list for every Python environment of the repository: each entry of 'environments' is built in the main clone, in file order, with all its requirements files in one pip call. pip-audit is a tool of the first environment only and audits the requirements files of all of them, so the other environments never gain pip-audit's dependencies. A path that does not exist is reported by name, never skipped (R3). An 'exclude' entry names a package the installer drops from a requirements file before pip sees it: the file itself is never edited, because the skill that owns it still wants the line.

environments.name: .venv-skills
environments.why: The interpreter of the offline suite, the dashboard and every skill script the repository runs.

requirements.why: paper2talk: test_to_a4 (pypdf), the Jinja render path (jinja2), test_talk_pptx (python-pptx), OOXML reads (defusedxml)

scopus: requests (scopus_api, download_pdf), google-genai and openai (reviewers), curl_cffi (publisher tier), playwright (browser_fetch tier 8; the Chromium binary is a separate 'playwright install chromium')
extract-statistic: pymupdf and pymupdf4llm (extract_text.py), markitdown and docling (Markdown backends, docling pulls torch, D4), psycopg and pgvector (corpus_index.py)
form-service: requests (pdf_ingest.py), pypdf (field_map.py, fill_form.py), pyHanko and cryptography (sign_form.py)
geolocalisation: matplotlib and pillow (generate_geomap.py, the PNG map)
loop-engineer: claude-agent-sdk (loop_engineer.py live loop), tiktoken (token_count.py --method tiktoken)
narrative-cv: PyYAML (cv_inventory.py, cv_common.py), pypdf (cv_build.py page-budget check)
rt-observe: faster-whisper (stt_engine.py, voice panel), psycopg (rt_store.py, optional), the three nvidia CUDA DLL packages stt_engine.add_cuda_dll_dirs puts on PATH (D5)
word2latex: pillow and numpy (docx_inspect.py image comparison)
wp-portfolio-sync: PyYAML (mapping and extras files), requests (wp_common.py WpClient), defusedxml (cihr_cv.py, parse_cv.py)

tools.why: security.md: pip-audit runs on every requirements file this installer applies. Pinned to the version found in the working environment on 2026-10-16; the install step used to call it without ever installing it.

environments.name: .venv-docs
environments.why: The interpreter that builds the MkDocs site (mkdocs build --strict, mkdocs gh-deploy).

requirements.why: mkdocs, mkdocs-material and the build hook scripts/docs/mkdocs_hooks.py, pinned with their transitives (D3)

environments.name: .venv-pdf2md
environments.why: The interpreter that runs pdf2md's conversion (mineru, mineru-llama-cpp). Kept apart by the owner on 2026-10-22: mineru 4.0.11 needs gradio, and every gradio up to 6.30.0 caps pillow below 13.0.0, the version that clears pillow 12.3.0's advisories in .venv-skills.

requirements.why: pdf2md: mineru and mineru-llama-cpp (the conversion engine), PyYAML, PyMuPDF (the second PDF reader of validate, repair and fix)

venv_probe_timeout_s.provenance: chosen 2026-10-16 (R4): a scratch 'python -m venv' takes a few seconds on this machine; the ceiling only has to be finite (R10) and generous on a slow disk
